faq.q: What is the quickest way to put a white backdrop behind a product photo?
faq.a: Upload the product photo, then choose a white backdrop. The finished image places the item on a clean white field.

faq.a: Some marketplaces ask for a pure white main image. Check the current category rule before you publish.

faq.q: Will a plain white backdrop flatten the product?
faq.a: Even lighting and a soft shadow keep depth while the backdrop stays plain.

faq.q: Can I post this image on Amazon or Shopify?

faq.q: Can one white treatment cover my whole catalog?
